actions.rationale: Empty sidecar. Deploy $55m of the $100m gross cap in the single cleanest USD spot: long USDCAD. Size is below cap to leave room if energy/CAD covering volatility rises, but large enough versus 3.85% SOFR vig if spot continues the incomplete 3m reversal. Trusted code must transact at the packet mid; no authored mark.

events.invalidation: Fed path recast as one-and-done and/or BoC/energy re-tightens CAD enough to close the policy gap.
events.rationale: FACT: Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00%; SOFR 3.85; US 2Y 4.76; SR3 still prices 4.32/4.58 at 3m/6m. FACT: CORRA 2.29; CA 2Y 3.27; CA-US 2Y -140bp; Canada labor gauge 38 versus US 75; Canada core near 2%. FACT: USDCAD 1.40105 is +1.74% 1m but still -1.25% 3m. INFERENCE: the USD-versus-CAD policy and labor gap is cleaner in spot than in rates because the sovereign/OIS differential is already extreme, while EURUSD/GBPUSD have already sold 1.9-2.1% 1m and AUDUSD still has AONIA/AU 2Y carry against a short. UNKNOWN: whether energy pass-through forces a faster BoC catch-up, and whether CAD short-covering completes without further USD upside.
